costReality.note: Report only: no verdict is changed. 0.8% = a 1,000 USD position with 3 USD fees each way (0.6%) plus about 0.2% spread; 0.4% = a 5,000 USD position (0.12% fees + spread); 0.2% = a zero-commission broker (spread only). The average after costs is exact for any cost (the mean shifts by the cost difference), so stored averages are used where a study keeps no per-trade list (method). "Edge" = vs the average stock bought the same day, which pays no cost in the house yardstick.
